mission: Release TOPA as a falsification-first research method across JANUS COSMOS to locate overlooked signal-analysis methods, false-positive traps, controls, calibration weaknesses and genuinely unresolved measurements relevant to TESLA SWEEP.
scientific_boundary: TOPA is a reproducible analysis protocol, not an independent sentient observer. Repository pattern mining may identify methods or questions; it cannot create physical evidence that is absent from the underlying data.

predeclared_hunt_lanes.question: Which old JANUS COSMOS experiments demonstrated that an attractive pattern can be created by a bad null model, selection effect or ordinary structure?
Which Cousteau gates show that receiver/sensor response, passband edges or calibration can manufacture apparent frequency structure?
Which prior corrections show that nominal or model-derived frequencies must not be called exact without uncertainty and spectral resolution?
Which JANUS methods already solve destructive-null, multiple-testing or empirical-p-resolution problems that Tesla Sweep could otherwise repeat?
Which prior gates distinguish repeated appearance from independent physical replication at the same source?
Which frozen non-semantic feature systems can be transferred to time-frequency spectrograms without importing semantic bias?
Which prior audits prevent OCR, cipher, face, message or meaning searches from feeding back into blind statistical admission?
Which acoustic or other signal families can be imported only as morphology controls, without claiming a physical causal connection?

next_physical_gate_after_method_hunt: Freeze realistic null families, power calculation, instrument metadata and uncertainty-aware fingerprint metrics before opening blind raw fields.
